resources.string: Learn the rules by playing. Follow the hints and press the highlighted button.
Press Income to take 1 coin. Nobody can block Income.
Now press Foreign Aid to take 2 coins. Anyone with a Duke could block it, but your opponent will allow it this time.
Well done! You pick one action each turn. With 10 or more coins you must Coup.
You hold a Duke. Press Tax to take 3 coins. Tax is an action that claims \"I am the Duke\".
You can claim a role while acting. If nobody doubts you, it just happens. You may claim a card you don\'t hold (bluffing), but it is risky if challenged.
Your opponent claims the Duke to collect Tax. In this exercise they are lying. Press Challenge!
Challenge won! A caught liar loses a card. If your challenge is wrong, you lose a card instead, so be careful.
Your opponent claims the Captain to steal your coins. You hold an Ambassador, so press \"Block with Ambassador\".
Blocked! Stealing can be blocked by the Captain or the Ambassador. A block is also a claim, so it can be challenged.
